card.name: Word endings after a split-off stem
card.fires_on: The final piece of a word split into parts, such as " se" in "per se", "fusion" in "Transfusion", and endings like "its", "ah", "ib" or "ans".

modes.label: per se
modes.description: The word "se" right after "per" in the phrase "per se".
modes.example: Hypotension is not per<< se>> a reason to discontinue captopril

modes.label: Transfusion
modes.description: "fusion" completing "Trans" at the start of transfusion-related terms.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: A closing piece of a longer name or word, such as a drug name or a loanword.
modes.example: increase ripretin<<ib>> dose frequency to twice daily
